```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(Seurat)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
mmc4 <- read_excel("data/mmc4.xlsx", sheet = "Fig4A.S3E") 
mmc4 <- read_excel("data/mmc4.xlsx", sheet = "Fig2A.S2A") 

colnames(mmc4)<- mmc4[2,]
mmc4 <- mmc4[4:nrow(mmc4),1:7] 
mmc4 <- mmc4%>% mutate(across(p_val:p_val_adj, as.numeric))
mmc4%>% mutate(avg_logFC=is.numeric(avg_logFC))
top_genes_fc <- mmc4 %>% filter(cluster %in% as.character(0:4)) %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(avg_logFC, n=10) %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()
top_genes_pct <- mmc4 %>% filter(cluster %in% as.character(0:4)) %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(pct.1, n=10) %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()


mmc4 %>% filter(gene %in% top_genes_fc) %>% group_by(cluster)%>%
  filter(cluster %in% as.character(0:4)) %>% 
    mutate(gene=factor(gene, levels = top_genes_fc ))%>%
  ggplot(aes(cluster, gene,size=pct.1, color=avg_logFC))+geom_point()

mmc4 %>% filter(gene %in% top_genes_pct) %>% 
  group_by(cluster)  %>% 
  filter(cluster %in% as.character(0:4)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(gene=factor(gene, levels = top_genes_pct ))%>%
  ggplot(aes(cluster,gene, size=pct.1, color=avg_logFC ))+geom_point()

mmc4 %>% filter(gene=="CD163")
names(mmc4)
```

```{r}
new_cluster_names<-
  c(
  `0`="Classical Monocytes",
  `7`="HLA DRhi CD83 Monocytes",
  `12`="CD163hi Monocytes 1_d7",
  `6`="HLA DRlo S100A Monocytes",
  `8`="Non classical Monocytes",
  `11`="Neutrophils",  
  `13`="Immature Neutrophils",
  `17`="mDCs",
  `18`="pDCs",
  `1`="CD4 T",
  `3`="CD4 T",
  `10`="CD4 T",
  `2`="CD8 T",
  `15`="CD8 T",
  `9`="CD8 T",
  `4`="NK",
  `5`="B",
  `19`="B",
  `20`="B",
  `16`="Plasmablasts",
  `14`="Megakaryocyte",
  `21`="mixed",
  `22`="undefined"
)
seurat_monocytes <-subset(x = seurat_c1_full_FG, idents = c("0","6","7","12","8"#, "11"#,"17"
                                                            ))
new_cluster_names_clean <- make_clean_names(new_cluster_names)
names(new_cluster_names_clean) <- names(new_cluster_names)
seurat_monocytes$cluster_clean <- new_cluster_names_clean[seurat_monocytes$RNA_snn_res.0.4 |> as.character()]
seurat_monocytes |> write_rds(paste0(path_data_file,
                                     "schulte_schrepping_monocytes_from_seurat_COVID19_PBMC_cohort1_10x_jonas_FG_2020-08-15.rds"))

seurat_monocytes_neutrophils <-subset(x = seurat_c1_full_FG, idents = c("0","6","7","12","8", "11","13"
                                                            ))
new_cluster_names_clean <- make_clean_names(new_cluster_names)
names(new_cluster_names_clean) <- names(new_cluster_names)
seurat_monocytes_neutrophils$cluster_clean <- new_cluster_names_clean[seurat_monocytes_neutrophils$RNA_snn_res.0.4 |> as.character()]
seurat_monocytes_neutrophils |> write_rds(paste0(path_data_file,
                                     "schulte_schrepping_monocytes_neutrophils_from_seurat_COVID19_PBMC_cohort1_10x_jonas_FG_2020-08-15.rds"))
seurat_monocytes_neutrophils <-  read_rds(paste0(path_data_file,
                                     "schulte_schrepping_monocytes_neutrophils_from_seurat_COVID19_PBMC_cohort1_10x_jonas_FG_2020-08-15.rds"))
```

```{r}
additional_markers %>% arrange(gene)
```

```{r}
seurat_monocytes_markers <- read_rds(paste0(path_data_file, "seurat_monocytes_markers.rds") )

hla_d_names <- seurat_monocytes@assays$RNA@data |> rownames() |> str_subset("HLA-D")
hla_d_data <- seurat_monocytes@assays$RNA@data[hla_d_names,] |> as.matrix() |>  t() |> 
  as_tibble() |>  
  rowMeans()
seurat_monocytes$hla_d <- hla_d_data
FindAllMarkers(seurat_monocytes,features = c("CD83"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0)

top_genes_fc <- seurat_monocytes_markers %>% #filter(cluster %in% as.character(0:4)) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(avg_log2FC, n=10) %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()
top_genes_pct <- seurat_monocytes_markers %>% 
 # filter(cluster %in% as.character(0:4)) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(pct.1, n=10) %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()


seurat_monocytes_markers %>% filter(gene %in% top_genes_fc) %>% group_by(cluster)%>%
  #filter(cluster %in% as.character(0:4)) %>% 
    mutate(gene=factor(gene, levels = top_genes_fc ))%>%
  ggplot(aes(cluster, gene,size=pct.1, color=avg_log2FC))+geom_point()+scale_color_gradient(low ="blue",
                                                                                             high="red")+scale_color_gradient2(midpoint=0, low="blue", mid="white",
                     high="red", space ="Lab" )
seurat_monocytes_markers %>% filter(gene %in% top_genes_pct) %>% 
  group_by(cluster)  %>% 
  #filter(cluster %in% as.character(0:4)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(gene=factor(gene, levels = top_genes_pct ))%>%
  ggplot(aes(cluster,gene, size=pct.1, color=avg_log2FC ))+geom_point()+scale_color_gradient(low ="blue",
                                                                                             high="red")+scale_color_gradient2(midpoint=0, low="blue", mid="white",
                     high="red", space ="Lab" )
```
